data.description: Elevation allows elements to be lifted from the background. It can be defined by applying drop shadows or other visual cues, such as color and borders

shadows.description: Elevation using shadows reflects a spatial relationship by indicating separation from the background or allowing content to be scrolled under another element. This design system uses minimal shadows, primarily for toggle controls.

levels.name: Toggle Thumb Shadow
levels.description: 18% black opacity / Blur: 6px / Y-offset: 2px - Subtle shadow for toggle switch thumb elements

levels.name: Code Shot Border Shadow
levels.description: Inset border shadow using 1px white stroke - Creates inner border effect for code screenshots in dark theme
